name: Live app
summary: An origin of the project's own — https://<id>.labs.abclegacyllc.com — so anyone can try the experiment in a browser without installing anything. A separate origin, not a path on the catalog, so one project's page can never read another's cookies or storage.

options.dist: optional — a directory of built files in your repository, e.g. "dist". Caddy serves it directly: no process, no port, nothing to keep alive. Build it in your own CI and commit it; the Labs server never runs npm for you.
options.spa: optional, default true when "dist" is set — serve index.html for unknown paths, which is what a client-routed app (React, Vue, Svelte) needs to survive a refresh. Set false for a plain multi-page site so a missing file is a real 404.
options.note: with no "dist", the origin is proxied to the process you run under the host capability, and your app serves itself at /

limits.static: served by Caddy — the same machinery as the catalog itself
limits.proxied: not rate limited yet, unlike the mcp capability. Prefer "dist" until that is built.
